(Japanese: '''VSディグダ''' ''VS {{tt|Digda|Diglett}}'') is the 67th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 27th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Gyara]] and {{TP|Bruno|Onix}} are both putting up a good fight. Gyara is using powerful {{type|Water}} attacks, but [[Bruno]]'s {{p|Onix}} is dodging them all by twisting its snake-like body! Then Onix {{m|bind}}s Gyara, immobilizing it. Gyara's head can still move, and it {{m|bite}}s down onto Onix. Then Onix {{m|Dig}}s underground, avoiding all attacks. {{Adv|Red}} recalls Gyara and sends out [[Saur]], who uses its vines to cover the ground, ready to defend against Onix. The moment Onix comes up, Saur uses all its vines to push Onix back. Suddenly, Onix's tail comes up from behind Red and smashes into him and Saur, sending them underground. Underground, there are several holes that Onix could come through, so Red is in a difficult dilemma. When Onix appears, it starts to charge at Saur. Saur braces itself, and is not hit. Bruno calls a time-out for some {{p|Diglett}} that Bruno would have been killed if he hadn't stopped his Onix. The Diglett get out of the way, and Bruno falls to the ground and bows, as if controlled by someone. [[Lorelei]] and [[Agatha]] appear. Lorelei talks about the circle of life and the [[Elite Four]]'s ambition. Agatha lets Red see that she has the Badge Energy Amplifier, and Red wonders what it is doing there. Lorelei tells Red that they ''really'' called him there because he had faced {{adv|Giovanni}} and they wanted Giovanni's {{Badge|Earth}}. She asks Red where the Earth Badge is. Red thinks of a way to get out from underground, and while thinking, he realizes that Bruno is being controlled by Lorelei and Agatha. ==Major events== * In a flashback, the battle between {{Adv|Red}} and [[Bruno]] continues. * In a flashback, [[Agatha]] and [[Lorelei]] interrupt the battle. * In a flashback, Agatha and Lorelei tell {{Adv|Red}} the reason he was called upon. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Seel}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} (fantasy) * [[Lorelei]] * [[Bruno]] * [[Agatha]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Gyara]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Seel}} ([[Lorelei]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Onix}} ({{OP|Bruno|Onix}}) * {{p|Gastly}} ([[Agatha]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Diglett}} (multiple) * {{p|Dugtrio}} * {{p|Pinsir}} (fantasy) * {{p|Onix}} (fantasy) * {{p|Pidgeot}} (fantasy) * {{p|Machamp}} (fantasy) * {{p|Graveler}} (fantasy) * {{p|Pikachu}} (fantasy) ==Trivia== * The English title of this chapter is based on the phrase "Can you dig it?". ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 地鼠|VS Diglett}} |cs=Vs.
